acrobaticsRogue.flavor:
The rooftop road of the frozen docks.

Bridge rail, lamp post, gutter, never the street. The Court's watch walked only the paved ways, for the paving had been blessed at the Founding and the rooftops had not.

Whether the watch was pious or idle is not agreed.
acrobaticsRogue.name: Acrobatics
acrobaticsRogue.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Draw {draw} cards. Discard 1 at random.

aegisOfEmbers.flavor:
A shield held into the fire until it glows.

The last captain of the Vanguard held the causeway so through the whole of the Burning. His shield was found welded to the stones, and his arm was not found at all.

The stones there are warm still, and soldiers kneel on them.
aegisOfEmbers.name: Aegis of Embers
aegisOfEmbers.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. If in Bulwark Stance: gain {strength} Strength.

afterimageCard.flavor:
Reflection left in the Regent's glass.

The mirrors of the Hall held a thief's image a heartbeat longer than they should. The Regent's stewards recorded it as the Hall's loyalty.

The glass has grown slower with each winter since the Burning.
afterimageCard.name: Afterimage
afterimageCard.textTemplate: Every third card you play grants 3 Block.

aimedShot.flavor:
One arrow, one seam in the armour.

The stitched knights of the Court wear plate sewn at the joints, and the stitching is the weak place. A dock archer who knows a surgeon's work knows where to aim.

Some of them learned it on the surgeons' tables.
aimedShot.name: Aimed Shot
aimedShot.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Prepared: deal {damage.2} more and apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable. Consume Prepared.

alterationCounter.flavor:
An old seam closes against the blow.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
alterationCounter.name: Alteration Counter
alterationCounter.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a alteration Counter: 1 Ward and 1 Poise return.

ambush.flavor:
Opening of the frozen docks.

Strike from beneath a bridge, from behind, before the other has decided there is a fight at all. The docks learned it from the Court's surgeons, who walked the bridges by night with their bags, and always arrived first.

Their day-books record house calls, but no houses.
ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Prepared: deal {damage.2} more. Apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable. Consume Prepared.

arrowVolley.flavor:
Loose, nock, loose again.

The dock crews kept a barrel of salvaged arrows beneath every stair, few of them straight. A volley did not need them straight, only many and quick, and the crews were both.

The barrels are empty now. Nobody admits to refilling them.
arrowVolley.name: Arrow Volley
arrowVolley.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies {hits} times.

ashCircle.flavor:
A ring of ash poured round the feet.

The apprentices drew one about the great lens each eclipse, to keep the dark from settling on the glass. On the last eclipse the ring was drawn, and the dark settled elsewhere.

Nobody inside the ring was harmed. Nobody outside it was found.
ashCircle.name: Ash Circle
ashCircle.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Starstone: apply {weak} Weak to ALL enemies.

ashOath.flavor:
Oath sworn in ash.

A smear upon each other's wrist, where the mark would have been; no witness, no name. It binds twice, once for each. The Court held that an unwitnessed oath binds no one.

The Court is sewn to its oaths now.
ashOath.name: Oath of Ash
ashOath.textTemplate: An ally gains {strength} Strength; you gain {strength.2}. Exhaust.

ashenMote.flavor:
A fleck of burnt chart, flung like a star.

When the Observatory's archive burned, the apprentice Hollis gathered its ash in jars, believing the charts might be read again. Some of it could be.

It reads the same sky, though not the one above the Observatory.

ashenMote.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage to the selected enemy.

ashfallRite.flavor:
The sky asked to rain ash, and answering.

The rite is recorded once, in Hollis's hand, on the night after the eclipse. It names no author. It names the Observatory as the altar, and the reach as the congregation.

The reach has been grey since, and is said to be listening.
ashfallRite.name: Ashfall Rite
ashfallRite.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies {hits} times. Starstone: apply {burn} Burn to ALL.

ashheartDragon.ashBreath.name: Ash_Breath
ashheartDragon.ashBreath.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage {hits} times. Charges for 1 turn.

aspDart.flavor:
Thorn of the river reeds, dipped in the second shelf.

The ice-cutters carry a pinch of it in a quill and spit it Near. The surgeons called the wound a bite and billed the bitten.

No asp has lived on the docks in living memory.
aspDart.name: Asp Dart
aspDart.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Poison damage leaves Venom behind.

assassinate.flavor:
Killing blow, struck after a single question.

The way of a dock thief who hunts one particular Court surgeon. The question has been told upon the docks; the surgeon's name has not. Some believe the question concerns a stitching. Others, that the surgeon is kin.

The docks have learned not to ask twice.
assassinate.name: Assassinate
assassinate.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Prepared: deal {damage.2} more. Consume Prepared. Exhaust.

astralArmorCard.flavor:
Mantle of cold light, after Starwatch Terrace.

The terrace upon the Drowned Coast was paved in starstone, that the apprentices might measure the new tower's draw. The paving never warmed, and the salt spray never dried upon it.

A Saint was sent to bless the stones. She asked to be posted elsewhere.
astralArmorCard.name: Astral Armor
astralArmorCard.textTemplate: At the end of your turn, gain 4 Block.

upgrade.textTemplate: At the end of your turn, gain 8 Block.

astralCleave.flavor:
Cut of cold force.

First seen when a falling fragment passed through the lens gallery and sheared the telescope in two before cooling upon the floor. The Astronomer recorded a fall. Maud Vell, at the eyepiece, called it a throw.

She was dismissed at the season's end.
astralCleave.name: Astral Cleave
astralCleave.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage and {poiseDamage} Poise damage. Starstone: deal {damage.2} more.

astralInsight.flavor:
Clear sight into the charts.

The apprentices believed the Starwatch's ledgers were meant to end where the charts of the fourth hearth began. There the Astronomer once underlined a line, and later struck through his own mark.

The charts of the fourth hearth were not among those carried away.
astralInsight.name: Astral Insight
astralInsight.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Draw {draw} card. Starstone: draw {draw.2} more.

astromancerCard.flavor:
The Starwatch's discipline, carried away.

An apprentice took the charts and left the Observatory before the eclipse. The Starwatch recorded it as theft. The apprentice's line in the roll has been scraped away.

Not so thoroughly that the name cannot be guessed.
astromancerCard.name: Astromancer
astromancerCard.textTemplate: At the start of your turn, gain Starstone Charge and draw a card.

attune.flavor:
First exercise of the apprentice.

Hold the stone until pulse and rhythm match. The Starwatch taught that starstone answers rhythm, not force, and credited the principle to the Astronomer.

The standing stones upon the marches road hum in the same rhythm. They are older than he.
attune.name: Attune

upgrade.textTemplate: Restore {restoreMana} Mana.

azureCoilCard.flavor:
Blue light that gathers about the working.

First seen around apprentices reciting the star tables aloud in rhythm. The Chapel's censor ruled the tables were written in an old script, and forbade their recitation.

The coil returned the following night.
azureCoilCard.name: Azure Coil
azureCoilCard.textTemplate: Whenever you play a Skill, gain 2 Block.

backstep.flavor:
Retreat of the lower-river ice-cutters.

The cutters know which ice beneath the bridges holds and which only seems to, and sell the knowledge by the season. Their map is drawn inside a cutter's coat and passed down with it.

Its present wearer says it has been wrong since the second winter.

backstep.name: Backstep

barbedArrow.flavor:
A head filed backward so it will not come out.

Fishhook smiths on the docks made them in secret, for the Court forbade barbs after a bailiff died of one. The smiths still make fishhooks.

The fish on the docks are said to be larger than they were.
barbedArrow.name: Barbed Arrow

barrageCounter.flavor:
The last arrow finds a sheltered hand.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
barrageCounter.name: Barrage Interception
barrageCounter.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a alteration Counter: 1 Ward and 1 Poise return.

base.attack-then-defend.flavor:
A returning stroke of the Bastion's gate watches.

The first instruction was never to leave the weapon where the blow ended. Guards practiced finding a new footing while the edge was still returning. Those who forgot were corrected by a wooden staff across the unprotected ribs.

A strike ends only when its bearer is ready.
base.attack-then-defend.name: Strike and Settle
base.attack-then-defend.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, then choose a maneuver stance.

base.auto-counter.flavor:
A waiting answer of the Bastion's shield masters.

Pupils stood behind a raised board while the instructor struck it without a count. They were forbidden to pursue the staff and taught instead to answer its contact. Years later, some could begin the reply before knowing they had been attacked.

The lesson waited in the arm.
base.auto-counter.name: Automatic Counter

base.auto-sweep.flavor:
A prepared circle of the ring road's caravan guards.

An escort surrounded by thieves could not watch every approach. Guards planted their feet and learned to turn at the first touch of a blade. The motion cleared space for the travelers, even when its bearer never saw the attacker.

The road was measured by the weapon's return.
base.auto-sweep.name: Automatic Sweep

base.bind.flavor:
Restraint of the Bastion's old holding rooms.

The Wardens preferred a knot that checked the striking arm and left its bearer able to eat. Several survived on the empty cells after the keys were lost. Their pattern needs no rope when traced in ash.

Mercy had a shape before a name.
base.bind.name: Bind

base.blight.flavor:
A wasting drawn from the Field Flame's ruins.

The first dark patches were cut from the orchards and buried beyond the walls. Shoots rose from the burial ground the following spring. By winter, the fruit within the city bore the same marks beneath its skin.

The gardeners ran out of clean ground.
base.blight.name: Blight
base.blight.textTemplate: Apply Blight {base.blight}: lethal when its stacks reach current HP.

base.break-poise.flavor:
A staggering blow of the Bastion's quarry crews.

Quarry workers drove wedges where the weight of a block already strained its bed. A short stroke could unsettle stone too large to break outright. Their fighting descendants sought the same yielding place beneath armor and planted feet.

What cannot be broken can still be moved.
base.break-poise.name: Poise Break

base.break-ward.flavor:
A disrupting touch of the Observatory's instrument keepers.

The keepers tested old seals before moving a lens from its housing. A precise disturbance could loosen a ward without shattering the glass beneath it. The method later found use against defenses made to protect less delicate things.

The opening is smaller than the harm it permits.
base.break-ward.name: Ward Break

base.buff-ally.flavor:
An encouragement kept by the Bastion's shared watches.

The guards touched a companion's shoulder before exchanging places at the gate. A small working grew around the gesture, lending tired arms some of the giver's resolve. It passed between survivors long after the gate ceased to stand.

The hand is withdrawn; the steadiness remains.
base.buff-ally.name: Ally Empowerment
base.buff-ally.textTemplate: Give an ally {strength} Strength for this combat.

base.charm.flavor:
A courtly working carried beyond the frozen bridges.

Petitioners learned to soften the attention of armed doorwardens before presenting their claims. The words lost their courtesy as the queues grew hungry. Their cadence still causes a raised weapon to hesitate before its appointed stroke.

An audience can be won without consent.
base.charm.name: Charm

base.conditional-damage-bonus.flavor:
A committed strike of the Bastion's breach fighters.

The guards held their heavier blows until their footing could carry the whole body forward. Striking from an unsettled guard wasted the opening and often the weapon. The old drill made patience part of an apparently reckless motion.

The strength was waiting beneath the stance.
base.conditional-damage-bonus.name: Conditional Strike
base.conditional-damage-bonus.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. In Smash stance, deal {damage.2} more.

base.cost-per-use.flavor:
An exacting stroke of the Citadel's formal duels.

A duelist was expected to end the matter before fatigue spoiled the prescribed line. Those forced to repeat it found the weapon heavier on each return. The body paid for an elegance that the watching Court rarely questioned.

A perfect motion does not become easier.
base.cost-per-use.name: Shifting Cost
base.cost-per-use.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Costs +1 SP per prior play this combat (maximum +3).

base.current-stance-variant.flavor:
An answering form of the Bastion's shield yard.

The same turn of the shoulder served different purposes under different weights. With a raised weapon it drove forward; behind a settled guard it closed the opening. Instructors judged the footing before they corrected the hands.

The body gives a motion its meaning.
base.current-stance-variant.name: Stance Echo
base.current-stance-variant.textTemplate: Smash: deal 12 damage. Otherwise gain {damage} Block.

base.damage-per-use.flavor:
A relentless exercise of the Bastion's quarry fighters.

Stone breakers struck along one line until the hidden fault yielded. Their children brought the practice into the shield yard, refusing to change a stroke that had not yet found its depth. Each return carried the weight of the last.

The fracture arrives before the stone admits it.
base.damage-per-use.name: Rising Damage
base.damage-per-use.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, increasing each time this card is played.

base.divine-cleanse.flavor:
An unbinding rite of the Court Flame's attendants.

The attendants washed petitioners' hands before an oath could be heard. Later, they traced the washing gesture over fetters and old curses. The water was long gone, but the motion still persuaded certain bonds to loosen.

A clean hand can carry an old wound.
base.divine-cleanse.name: Divine Cleanse

base.divine-harm.flavor:
An inversion found beneath the river city's shrines.

The shrines offered comfort to those whom the Court would not hear. After the Burning, their bowls filled with black water and the comforting words turned bitter. A practiced hand can direct that bitterness toward another's blessing.

The prayer arrives with its meaning reversed.
base.divine-harm.name: Profane Inversion
base.divine-harm.textTemplate: Convert the enemy’s Sacred healing into damage for {base.divine-harm} turns.

base.divine-strike.flavor:
Consecrated stroke of the Citadel knights.

A knight once carried the Court Flame's promise along the edge of a plain weapon. The oath was spoken before each watch, whether anyone remained to hear it or not. Some blades still answer the gesture.

The promise survived its intended keeper.
base.divine-strike.name: Smite
base.divine-strike.textTemplate: Deal {damage} weapon damage and {damage.2} Sacred damage.

base.drain-allies.flavor:
A shared defense of the ring road's last escorts.

An escort sometimes closed ranks around the weakest traveler and bore the blows together. A harsher working drew the price from every companion before any enemy struck. The traveler it saved was left to remember each willing face.

Shelter can leave wounds on either side.
base.drain-allies.name: Shared Sacrifice
base.drain-allies.textTemplate: All allies lose {loseHp} HP. Gain {block} Block.

base.draw.flavor:
A preparation shared by the ring road's survivors.

Travelers kept a useful thing within reach and another beneath it, wrapped against the wet. Those who returned from the towers made the same small preparations before sleeping. A ready hand mattered more than a crowded pack.

The next necessity rarely announces itself.
base.draw.name: Draw

base.elemental-weapon.flavor:
A furnace blessing carried on ordinary steel.

The Saints warmed the tools of workers assigned to the Observatory's outer stair. When the fuel carts stopped, a few tools retained their borrowed heat. Their owners discovered that the same blessing could be laid upon a blade.

The furnace asks no purpose of iron.
base.elemental-weapon.name: Elemental Weapon
base.elemental-weapon.textTemplate: Enchant your weapon with Fire for {base.elemental-weapon} turns.

base.ethereal.flavor:
A brief shelter drawn from the Observatory's fading glass.

The outer windows once softened the heat that gathered beneath the great lens. Shards carried away after the Burning could still hold a pale screen for an instant. In an unwatched hand, they crumbled before the next breath.

The shelter lasts only while it is needed.
base.ethereal.name: Ethereal

base.evade.flavor:
Footwork of the weald's narrow river crossings.

Bridge keepers taught travelers to turn sideways when a laden cart passed. During the fighting, the movement became a way to let steel pass just as closely. It requires little ground, and leaves little room for doubt.

The river took those who stepped twice.
base.evade.name: Evade

base.exhaust.flavor:
A final reserve of the road's exhausted climbers.

Those who reached a landing wounded sometimes bound their last clean cloth around their chest and stood. There would be no second dressing at the next stair. The resolve of that moment became a working taught without ceremony.

The cloth is spent before the climb is.
base.exhaust.name: Exhaust

base.exhaust-choose.flavor:
A deliberate sacrifice of the road's traveling schools.

A climber cannot carry every lesson into every chamber. Teachers made their pupils lay one practiced movement aside before opening a difficult door. The empty place left room for attention, though the surrendered habit sometimes proved hard to recover.

Readiness has always required a leaving behind.
base.exhaust-choose.name: Chosen Exhaust
base.exhaust-choose.textTemplate: Choose a hand card to exhaust.

base.extra-shield.flavor:
A returning defense of the Citadel's bridge watches.

Two guards once shared each narrow post, turning their shields in a practiced sequence. After the watches thinned, a survivor had to answer both parts alone. Their descendants learned the second turn without ever seeing the partner it replaced.

The empty post still has its appointed movement.
base.extra-shield.name: Extra Shield
base.extra-shield.textTemplate: Gain {base.extra-shield} extra shield action this turn.

base.extra-weapon.flavor:
A second opening of the Bastion's veteran guards.

The newest recruits counted attacks as separate exertions. Veterans learned to keep the weapon moving while the first opponent still recoiled, finding another opening before the line closed. The extra stroke depended on preparation made before either enemy moved.

The interval belonged to the ready hand.
base.extra-weapon.name: Extra Weapon
base.extra-weapon.textTemplate: Gain {base.extra-weapon} extra weapon action this turn.

base.fire-cleanse.flavor:
A harsh remedy of the Cinder Reach.

Mine workers burned spoiled dressings before returning beneath the ridge. In the last winters, the remedy was applied before the cloth was removed. Those who endured it escaped the creeping sickness, though none called the treatment gentle.

Clean flesh still bears the fire's account.
base.fire-cleanse.name: Purifying Flame
base.fire-cleanse.textTemplate: Take {damage} Fire damage. Remove Poison and Greased.

base.force-stance.flavor:
A coercive feint of the Citadel's shield masters.

The masters taught a threatening step that made an opponent cover before choosing to do so. In practice the wooden blade stopped short. Beyond the yard, the same step could close a fighter inside a defense they had not intended.

A guard can become its own confinement.
base.force-stance.name: Force Stance

base.foresight.flavor:
An exercise of the Observatory's night students.

Apprentices watched a candle's reflection through a bowl of dark water before they were allowed near the lenses. The practice taught them to notice a movement before seeking its cause. Few saw farther than the next breath.

That breath was sometimes sufficient.
base.foresight.name: Foresight

base.gain-resource.flavor:
A measured recovery of the weald's ridge workers.

Workers rested at marked stones on the climb to the Bastion, setting their loads down before their knees failed. The short interval was counted in steady breaths. Fighters learned to find the same recovery without leaving their place in the line.

Rest need not wait for a safe road.
base.gain-resource.name: Resource Gain

base.generate-smash.flavor:
A recalled stroke of the Citadel's heavy weapon drills.

A recruit carried a wooden mallet before being trusted with the armory's iron. Instructors made its simple downward path the last exercise of every watch. Even an empty hand could remember the weight when no suitable weapon remained.

The practiced burden waits for another shape.
base.generate-smash.name: Smash Creation
base.generate-smash.textTemplate: Add a temporary Smash to hand.

base.greased.flavor:
Lamp oil prepared for the lower city's alleys.

Before the Burning, porters spread this heavy mixture beneath wheels to move stone uphill. The desperate later poured it across thresholds instead. Those who slipped could rise again, provided no one brought a torch.

The stair keeps both kinds of stain.
base.greased.name: Grease
base.greased.textTemplate: Apply Greased {base.greased}: fire detonates the coating.

base.growth-per-type.flavor:
A defense assembled from the ring road's scattered schools.

The towers once demanded separate loyalties from their fighters. On the roads between them, survivors exchanged the movements that had kept them alive. A guard became stronger when it could answer more than one kind of danger.

No ruined school could afford its old pride.
base.growth-per-type.name: Discipline Growth
base.growth-per-type.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block, scaling with distinct types played this turn.

base.guard-allies.flavor:
A sheltering oath of the Bastion's road wardens.

The Wardens walked between the wagons and the tree line, keeping their shields toward the unseen ground. An escort was judged by who arrived behind them, rather than by wounds received. The oath endured after the wagons stopped coming.

An empty road can still be guarded.
base.guard-allies.name: Interpose
base.guard-allies.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block and guard allies for {base.guard-allies} turn.

base.hide-cards.flavor:
A concealment practiced by the river city's couriers.

Messages were sewn inside an empty fold rather than beneath a conspicuous seal. Some couriers learned to put the fold itself beyond a searcher's touch. What they hid returned later, sometimes after its appointed recipient was gone.

An absent thing can still keep its appointment.
base.hide-cards.name: Conceal
base.hide-cards.textTemplate: Gain {base.conceal} Conceal. Hide X hand cards for X turns, where X is your Conceal stacks.

base.immediate-stance-transition.flavor:
A passing form of the road's traveling duelists.

A lesson borrowed in one city rarely answered every danger in the next. Travelers practiced changing their footing between breaths rather than between engagements. Those who managed it could leave an old commitment before an enemy found its opening.

The road did not wait for a formal beginning.
base.immediate-stance-transition.name: Flowing Transition

base.intangible.flavor:
A thinning learned among the Observatory's cold rooms.

Students were told to stand where the lens cast no image and listen for their own footsteps. Those who mastered the lesson could cross a door without stirring its hanging cloth. They returned colder than the stone.

The cloth never marked their passage.
base.intangible.name: Intangible

base.mirrors.flavor:
A fractured defense of the river city's salons.

The old houses hung polished plates beside their doors to multiply a guest's arrival. After the bridges froze, household magicians learned to give those reflections a brief weight. Intruders struck the nearest figure and heard glass break.

The remaining guest need not be real.
base.mirrors.name: Mirrors

base.modify-card-range.flavor:
An extending art of the weald's polearm keepers.

The keepers borrowed the motions of shorter weapons when the bridge left no room for a proper swing. A loosened grip and a careful step gave the remembered stroke another span. Its origin remained visible only to a patient teacher.

Distance changes the reach of an old lesson.
base.modify-card-range.name: Extend
base.modify-card-range.textTemplate: Choose a hand card. Change its range to Reach this combat.

base.modify-card-stance.flavor:
A forceful correction of the Citadel's dueling schools.

Instructors sometimes placed a heavier practice blade into a pupil's hands without warning. A familiar technique then required a different commitment of shoulder and hip. The lesson was carried into battle by fighters who could no longer choose their tools.

The old motion accepted a different weight.
base.modify-card-stance.name: Reframe
base.modify-card-stance.textTemplate: Choose a hand card. Change its maneuver to Smash this combat.

base.multi-hit.flavor:
A repeated stroke of the weald's short-blade escorts.

In a crowded passage, there was no room to draw back for a great blow. Escorts learned to strike along the returning path, turning small openings into a succession of wounds. The enemy's guard had to answer every movement separately.

A narrow space need not mean a single chance.
base.multi-hit.name: Multiple Strikes
base.multi-hit.textTemplate: Strike {hits} times for {damage} damage. Deal {poiseDamage} Ward and 3 Poise damage total.
base.multi-hit.wardOffTextTemplate: Strike {hits} times for {damage} damage. Deal {poiseDamage} Poise damage total.

base.multi-stance.flavor:
A divided discipline of the road's wandering instructors.

No tower trained a pupil to hold two answers at once. The travelers who taught between the seats had fewer certainties and more scars. They learned to keep one motion ready while the body seemed committed to another.

The road required room for a second lesson.
base.multi-stance.name: Many Forms
base.multi-stance.textTemplate: Gain {base.many-forms} Many Forms: hold up to 2 stances until next turn.

base.necrotic-heal.flavor:
A forbidden recovery of the Furnace Chapel.

The sick were once kept apart from the Chapel's warm stones. A few learned to draw sustenance from the very cold that gathered around their beds. They survived to leave the rooms, carrying no warmth that others could share.

The cure did not restore their welcome.
base.necrotic-heal.name: Necrotic Renewal
base.necrotic-heal.textTemplate: Convert incoming Necrotic damage to healing for {base.necrotic-healing} turns.

base.one-use-scroll.flavor:
A foresight exercise copied by an Observatory apprentice.

The student traced each curve slowly enough to remember the next before the ink dried. A traveler could later borrow that moment of clarity by opening the sheet. Its careful lines blackened as soon as they were read.

The lesson survived for one more pupil.
base.one-use-scroll.name: Spell Scroll
base.one-use-scroll.textTemplate: Cast Foresight. One play per combat; exhaust this scroll.

base.paid-resource-variant.flavor:
A borrowed cadence of the Observatory's armed attendants.

Some attendants could kindle a spell along the motion of a blade. Others repeated the same motion without its light and found it settled into a serviceable guard. Both remained in the drills after the teachers stopped distinguishing them.

The hand remembers whether it carried fire.
base.paid-resource-variant.name: Resource Echo
base.paid-resource-variant.textTemplate: If MP was paid, deal {damage} damage; otherwise gain 8 Block.

base.paralysis-status-card.flavor:
A lingering command of the river city's gaolers.

The fingers close without taking hold of anything. The old restraint needs neither a chain nor a prisoner who remembers the charge.

Release comes after the moment it was needed.
base.paralysis-status-card.name: Paralysis
base.paralysis-status-card.textTemplate: Skip your next action when drawn. Ethereal.

base.pay-x-effect.flavor:
An undivided exertion of the road's solitary climbers.

A locked stair offers no promise of another attempt. Some climbers learned to gather every remaining measure of effort into one committed motion. What followed depended on whether the obstruction or the climber gave way first.

Nothing was kept for the next landing.
base.pay-x-effect.name: Channel X
base.pay-x-effect.textTemplate: Spend all remaining SP. Deal {damage} damage.

base.pay-x-targets.flavor:
A widening assault of the Bastion's crowded breach drills.

The instructors packed the yard with wooden figures when recruits grew too certain of a single opponent. A fighter learned to carry one movement across as many openings as their strength allowed. The yard left no place to rest.

A breach seldom admits only one enemy.
base.pay-x-targets.name: Spread X
base.pay-x-targets.textTemplate: Spend all remaining SP. Deal {damage} damage to up to X enemies.

base.perception-untargetable.flavor:
A veiling art of the river city's hidden messengers.

Couriers crossed occupied bridges by moving where a watcher's attention had just departed. A small working deepened that omission until a searching gaze passed over them. Those with a practiced eye could still find the disturbance in the crowd.

A missing figure leaves an occupied space.
base.perception-untargetable.name: Veil
base.perception-untargetable.textTemplate: Become untargetable without a perception check for {base.veil} turns.

base.persistent-protection.flavor:
Armor charm of the Bastion watch.

The ridge gates were held through long winters by guards too few to relieve one another. Their warding knots were tied into the lining, renewing a thin defense whenever the wearer could stand and breathe.

The cloth outlasted several suits of iron.
base.persistent-protection.name: Ward Armor
base.persistent-protection.textTemplate: Gain Persistent Block {base.persistent-block} and Persistent Barrier {base.persistent-barrier}.

base.poison.flavor:
Bitter preparation of the weald's abandoned gardens.

The gardeners marked dangerous roots with white stakes so children could gather safely. When the Field Flame failed, the stakes were burned for warmth and the beds grew together. Their harvest now travels in stoppered bottles.

Nothing on the label promises a cure.
base.poison.name: Poison
base.poison.textTemplate: Apply {base.poison} Poison: 15 total Necrotic damage as it decays.

base.recall-choose.flavor:
A recovery drill of the Bastion's shield yard.

Novices were made to repeat a failed movement after every other student had taken a turn. The delay stripped away haste and left the motion clear. Veterans carried the drill into fights that offered no patient teacher.

What was abandoned need not be lost.
base.recall-choose.name: Recall
base.recall-choose.textTemplate: Choose a discarded card to return to hand.

base.recover-exile.flavor:
An old retrieval practiced at the Observatory's refuse stair.

Broken instruments were cast into a pit beneath the workshops. Poor apprentices climbed down for pieces the masters considered spent. Sometimes a discarded lens revealed a star the great glass had missed for an entire season.

The refuse retained its own small light.
base.recover-exile.name: Exile Recovery
base.recover-exile.textTemplate: Choose an exhausted card to return to hand.

base.reflect.flavor:
A returning ward of the Observatory's polished chambers.

The lens workers fitted their masks with silvered plates against sudden flares. A few plates sent more than light back toward its origin. The attendants preserved the pattern after the workshops emptied, though the reflected pain had no brightness.

What strikes the surface finds its way home.
base.reflect.name: Reflect
base.reflect.textTemplate: Reflect eligible incoming damage for {base.reflect} turn.

base.restrained.flavor:
A burdening seal of the Court's prisoners.

Those brought over the bridges wore weighted cords beneath their sleeves. They could walk to judgment, but every movement reminded them of the escort. The cords rotted in the river vaults; the imposed weight remained in their knots.

The sentence travels lighter than its iron.
base.restrained.name: Restrain
base.restrained.textTemplate: Apply Restrained {base.restrained}. Add a Restrained burden to the enemy hand.

base.restrained-status-card.flavor:
A remembered weight from the Court's holding rooms.

The cord is gone, but each movement still pays its toll. Prisoners learned to make fewer gestures while waiting for a door to open.

The burden has outlived its fastening.
base.restrained-status-card.name: Restrained
base.restrained-status-card.textTemplate: Your actions cost +1 SP while this burden is held. Ethereal.

base.retain.flavor:
A keeper's habit from the Bastion granaries.

When the harvest was sound, each storekeeper set aside a measure that could not be touched at market. The custom remained after the stores were emptied. Fighters learned to reserve a useful movement with the same stubborn care.

Hunger is not the only thing to anticipate.
base.retain.name: Retain
base.retain.textTemplate: Choose up to 2 hand cards to retain.

base.retain-block.flavor:
A settled guard of the Citadel's long watches.

The bridge guards learned to hold their shields through the quiet between assaults without letting the shoulders slacken. Their stance preserved work already done instead of demanding it anew. The practice remained useful when the bridges became a frozen road.

The pause does not belong to the attacker.
base.retain-block.name: Hold Block
base.retain-block.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Retain Block for {base.retain-block} turn.

base.reveal-opponent-hand.flavor:
A watcher's discipline of the Citadel bridges.

Doorwardens learned to read a visitor's hands before accepting any spoken purpose. The habit became more exact when the river froze and armed supplicants arrived together. A pause at the wrist could reveal more than a drawn blade.

Intent leaves a mark before iron moves.
base.reveal-opponent-hand.name: Read Intent
base.reveal-opponent-hand.textTemplate: Gain {base.read-intent}. Reveal the selected enemy's intent and burden hand for 1 turn.

base.scale-damage-taken.flavor:
A reprisal taught among the Bastion's battered gate guards.

Relief seldom came before the second assault. The guards learned to turn the force that drove them backward into the next blow forward. Those who survived could tell the cost of a watch by its last strike.

The gate remembered every attempt to break it.
base.scale-damage-taken.name: Reprisal Growth
base.scale-damage-taken.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, scaling with HP lost this turn.

base.scale-negative-status.flavor:
A cruel calculation of the river city's interrogators.

The interrogators kept separate marks for cold, hunger, and the smaller pains inflicted between questions. Each new mark narrowed a prisoner's remaining resistance. Their successors learned to strike where several afflictions had already begun their work.

The ledger counted injuries as opportunities.
base.scale-negative-status.name: Affliction Scaling
base.scale-negative-status.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, scaling with distinct negative statuses.

base.scout.flavor:
A pathfinder's method on the old viaducts.

The first travelers after the Burning tested each arch with a weighted cord before bringing the others forward. They marked the sound stones in an order the wind could not erase. Later parties sometimes found the marks rearranged.

A known road must still be examined.
base.scout.name: Scout
base.scout.textTemplate: Look at the top 3 cards. Choose their order.

base.shuffle-deck.flavor:
An ordering exercise of the Observatory's apprentices.

The students sorted loose charts until each could name their place by touch. Their teachers then scattered the stack and ordered them to begin again. The exercise continued after the charts ceased to describe the sky outside.

No arrangement was permitted to become certain.
base.shuffle-deck.name: Deck Shuffle

base.shuffle-hand.flavor:
A road lesson taught with a traveler's worn cards.

Caravan guards changed their watches whenever the same sequence grew familiar. A dangerous habit could be broken by putting every expected duty aside and taking another. The method survived on roads where there were no caravans left.

Familiarity is a route an enemy learns.
base.shuffle-hand.name: Hand Shuffle
base.shuffle-hand.textTemplate: Shuffle up to {draw} random hand cards into draw. Draw 3.

base.smash.flavor:
A heavy stroke remembered from the Bastion's stone yards.

A block that resisted the first careful blow sometimes needed the whole weight of the worker behind the next. The motion passed from mallet to weapon without losing its patient preparation or its unkind finish.

The arm follows where the body has committed.
base.smash.name: Smash

base.stagger-status-card.flavor:
An interruption carried by a broken bell's cadence.

The body seeks the missing beat and finds no footing. By the time its balance returns, the opening has already passed.

The next step belongs to someone else.
base.stagger-status-card.name: Stagger
base.stagger-status-card.textTemplate: Skip your next action when drawn. Ethereal.

base.stat-buff.flavor:
A strengthening rite of the Bastion's stone carriers.

Laborers pressed both palms against the first block before beginning the morning's lift. The gesture steadied tired arms through a day on the ridge. Their descendants found the same borrowed resolve useful beneath a weapon's weight.

Stone taught the hand before steel did.
base.stat-buff.name: Empower

base.status-card-paralyze.flavor:
A locking curse of the river city's empty cells.

The gaolers kept certain prisoners still without tightening their chains. Its pattern was scratched into the doorframes for a replacement watch to learn. The cells are open now, but the old instruction can still seize a living limb.

An open door does not release everything.
base.status-card-paralyze.name: Paralyzing Burden
base.status-card-paralyze.textTemplate: Add 2 Paralysis burdens to the enemy deck.

base.status-card-stagger.flavor:
A stumbling curse carried in the Court's broken bells.

The bridge bells once kept the procession moving at a measured pace. When their towers fell, the sound arrived in uneven fragments. Those who caught its rhythm faltered in midstride, as though the next stone had been taken away.

The missing beat leaves a place for steel.
base.status-card-stagger.name: Staggering Burden
base.status-card-stagger.textTemplate: Add 2 Stagger burdens to the enemy deck.

base.strike.flavor:
A plain stroke shared by the ring road's survivors.

Each tower claimed a finer school, and each school began by teaching the hand to carry an edge straight toward its mark. Travelers kept that first lesson when the schools and their quarrels were left behind.

The simplest instruction still has work to do.
base.strike.name: Strike

base.transform.flavor:
A simplifying art of the Bastion's oldest instructors.

The instructors stripped elaborate exercises back to the first straight blow whenever a pupil grew confused. Finer details could be learned again after the hands stopped trembling. In the towers, that patient correction became a swift and necessary spell.

A beginning can still serve an ending.
base.transform.name: Transform
base.transform.textTemplate: Transform a chosen hand card into Strike for this combat.

base.transmute.flavor:
A frugal working of the Cinder Reach's traveling smiths.

Broken tools were weighed before they entered the furnace, and nothing useful was thrown away whole. Some smiths learned to draw cinders from a spent working with the same care. The recovered warmth bought another small necessity along the road.

What is surrendered leaves something in the palm.
base.transmute.name: Transmute
base.transmute.textTemplate: Exhaust a chosen hand card. Gain {addCinders} cinders.

base.weak.flavor:
A loosening charm once laid upon dangerous beasts.

Wardens used these small workings to bring wounded animals home without further harm. After the Burning, the same gestures were taught at the gate. It was easier to carry a prisoner who could no longer struggle.

The hand remembers its gentler purpose.
base.weak.name: Weaken

bashingBlow.flavor:
Blow of whatever is heavy.

A cudgel, a mallet, a shovel from a mine camp. The reach's miners swing it at things in the lower galleries that were miners once. Foreman Coll says not to look at their hands, which remember the work.

His camp has lost fewer than any other.
bashingBlow.name: Bashing Blow

bindingParry.flavor:
The blade caught, turned, and held aside.

A duelling master of the Court taught it for coin to anyone who asked, dock thieves among them. When the Court learned whom he had taught, it stitched his hands.

He teaches it still, by describing it.
bindingParry.name: Binding Parry
bindingParry.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Prepare Melee Counter. Become Prepared. Draw {draw} card.

bladeDanceRogue.flavor:
Cuts in the figure of the Marionettes' dance.

The surgeons stitched the Court's dancers to their dance when the Court Flame died, and they perform upon the frozen river for no one. The dance was meant to end at dawn.

A small Marionette on the Fourth Bridge waits for the ending. Thieves leave her coins.
bladeDanceRogue.name: Blade Dance
bladeDanceRogue.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage {hits} times. Prepared: deal {damage.2} damage {hits.2} times. Consume Prepared.

blightBloom.flavor:
Red flowers upon the graves of the crown-born.

They first appeared in the Furnace Chapel's garden in the Long Winter. The remnant tends them as a sign that the dead are giving yet.

They spread fastest where the earth is freshly turned. The remnant has begun turning more.
blightBloom.name: Blight Bloom
blightBloom.textTemplate: Double the target's Blight (Crimson and Necrotic). In expanded combat, stops at 3 stacks each. Exhaust.

blightNova.flavor:
Reading of every name, aloud and at once.

Composed by the Furnace Saint after the Burning. The novices say it is what the fire did that night, and that the rite exists so it will be remembered. The remnant holds it holiest of the liturgies.

It has never been performed to its end.
blightNova.name: Blight Nova
blightNova.textTemplate: Deal damage equal to twice the target's Blight.

upgrade.textTemplate: Deal damage equal to three times the target's Blight.

blightTouch.flavor:
Blessing of the Feral Ember.

Taken from the Chapel's blessing of the sick and turned to what the Feral Ember holds its truer purpose: to give warmth and keep no account. The Saints name it heresy.

The converts say the touch is warm. None have said otherwise.

blightedBlightward.flavor:
The brand shelters what it has begun to claim.

The first black veins were mistaken for soot beneath the skin. Those who carried the mark learned that a borrowed breath left a debt after the flame had gone. Some grew stronger while counting it; none found the count growing smaller.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

blightedSecondBloom.flavor:
Black roots offer a second flowering.

The first black veins were mistaken for soot beneath the skin. Those who carried the mark learned that a borrowed breath left a debt after the flame had gone. Some grew stronger while counting it; none found the count growing smaller.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

blightedTransmute.flavor:
A borrowed breath leaves its name in ash.

The first black veins were mistaken for soot beneath the skin. Those who carried the mark learned that a borrowed breath left a debt after the flame had gone. Some grew stronger while counting it; none found the count growing smaller.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

blightward.flavor:
Cloth laid over an unfinished brand.

Begun for the Herald, whose mark began to burn on the night of the Burning and stopped partway. The Chapel remnant now lays such cloths over the brands of its dead, and teaches that the fire will return to finish its work.

The fire started on me and stopped. I do not know why.

blightwardLash.flavor:
Scourge turned upon one's own rot.

A discipline the Herald took up after the Burning: to cut the Blight from their own flesh and turn it outward. The Chapel remnant condemns it as heresy against the fire's gift.

Twice the remnant has sent a novice to ask how it is done.
blightwardLash.name: Blightward Lash
blightwardLash.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight. Lose {loseHp} HP.

blindingSand.flavor:
Ash thrown in the eyes.

The hamlets learned in the first winter that what came out of the weald flinched from ash as the living do. Some took this as proof the corrupted could be saved.

Marl's Hollow took it as proof they could be blinded. Marl's Hollow endures.
blindingSand.name: Blinding Sand
blindingSand.textTemplate: Apply {weak} Weak to ALL enemies. Exhaust.

bloodHarvest.flavor:
Reaping of the field of the marked.

So the liturgy names the gathering of names at the close of a plague year. The Saints went out with sickles and ledgers, and the rite is spoken throughout as thanksgiving.

We reap the field of the marked, and give thanks.

bloodHarvest.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies, scaling with Stamina spent. Then heal 3 per Stamina.

bloodOfferingRite.flavor:
Bowl filled with the officiant's own blood.

From the Chapel's first years, when the Saints were few; revived by the Furnace Saint after the Burning, when they were fewer. He performs it daily, and grows thin.

The bowl is always full.
bloodOfferingRite.name: Blood Offering

bloodPact.flavor:
Second office of the birth-rite.

The flame-mark was pressed into the newborn's wrist, and the parents answered in the child's stead. The Chapel called it a promise and a privilege.

In the birth-roll of the crown-born wards, beside the Herald's name, one word is struck through.
bloodPact.name: Blood Pact
bloodPact.textTemplate: Lose {loseHp} HP. Gain {gainEnergy} Stamina. Draw {draw} card.

bloodTithe.flavor:
Harvest tithe of the weald, paid in blood.

Given at the Bastion's field-shrine in years the grain failed. The Wardens called it voluntary, and kept no names, as a courtesy to the givers.

The tithe-roll lengthens with each year of the Mark Trade, and the villages it lists grow fewer.
bloodTithe.name: Blood Tithe
bloodTithe.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, plus double the Bleed on the target. Apply {bleed} Bleed.

bloodhuntersStrike.flavor:
Strike of the Bastion kennels.

Taught by the kennelmaster before the hounds turned. The kennel book names them the finest in the three cities, trained upon the scent of blood alone, and never loosed on the weald's own people.

After the Burning, the hamlets' dogs were found in those same kennels.
bloodhuntersStrike.name: Bloodhunter's Strike
bloodhuntersStrike.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, plus 1 for each Bleed on the target.

bloodletterRogue.flavor:
Bleeding, as the Citadel's surgeons practised it.

Their receipts name the patient, the measure drawn, and the patient's satisfaction, marked on every surviving copy. The surgeons held that bleeding balanced a courtier's humours before an oath.

Receipts from the last month before the Burning bear no names.
bloodletterRogue.name: Bloodletter

upgrade.textTemplate: Double the target's Bleed.

bloodletting.flavor:
Bleeding before the blessing of bread.

The Saints bled into the bowl first, that nothing be taken from the congregation the Saint had not first given. The Chapel taught it as humility.

On the days of the rite, the bread ran short, and the Saints ate first.
bloodletting.name: Bloodletting

brace.flavor:
The crouch before either stance.

Knees bent, weight low, the body made ready to be struck. The field-book gives it the first page, and calls it the one lesson all Wardens learned alike, sworn or hired, marked or not.

A later hand has corrected it.
brace.name: Brace

bracingStance.flavor:
First stance of the Bastion recruit.

Feet planted, shield braced against the Bastion's own wall, before either true stance was taught. Drillmaster Hask taught it thirty winters.

Her last entry is a roll of recruits, every name struck through but one, and that one scraped away.

butterflyPlague.flavor:
Red moths of the Furnace Chapel's ossuary.

They dwelt among the bones for as long as the Chapel kept records, and were called the ossuary's keepers. After the Burning, they left the ossuary for the reach.

We loose the red moths from the ossuary; they know the way.

butterflyPlague.textTemplate: Lose {loseHp} HP. Apply {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight to ALL enemies.

celestialLance.flavor:
Spear of light, horizon to zenith.

Chart 58 records such a line, lasting a single breath, sourced to a star upon no other chart. The Astronomer entered it as a fault of optics, then spent a week grinding a new lens he was never seen to use.

Chart 58 is the last he signed.

cheapShot.flavor:
Blow at the already wounded.

The Tollmouth fence calls it the only honest bargain on the river, and charges for lessons in teeth. He says he learned the practice from a Court magistrate who levied fines the same way.

The jar upon his counter is nearly full.
cheapShot.name: Cheap Shot
cheapShot.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. If the target is Weak, deal {damage.2} more.

cinderLance.flavor:
A shaft of burning ash, cold at its point.

The Astronomer's first experiment with the ash of starstone, logged as a failure: the ash burned without heat. His apprentices kept the log.

Where the lance struck the Observatory's wall, frost still forms each night.
cinderLance.name: Cinder Lance

cinderSigil.flavor:
A star traced in hot ash.

The Observatory's apprentices drew them on the terrace to fix a sighting, and swept them away at dawn. After the eclipse the sigils would not sweep; they had burned into the stone.

The terrace is covered in them now, none drawn by hand.

clearHead.flavor:
Watch the shoulders before the blade.

Recruits practiced on the Bastion's worn courtyard until their boots found the same stones without looking. Veterans watched the shoulders rather than the weapon. After the Burning, the surviving lessons were passed from one tired pair of hands to another.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cleavingBlow.flavor:
Heavy sweep of the weald hamlets.

Learned by watching the Wardens from beyond the walls, for no Warden would teach the unmarked. It is swung in the winters when blight-hounds come down out of the lanternwood in packs.

The Wardens called the weald their charge. The hamlets paid for that charge in spring grain.

colossusSmash.flavor:
Blow at the joints of something vast.

Learned against the Goldbough Avatar, the heraldic idol kneeling in a clearing of the weald, a sapling grown through it. It does not know the kingdom is gone.

It is carved stone and gilt. It flinches all the same.
colossusSmash.name: Colossus Smash

cometFragment.flavor:
Sorcery of the Starwatch, the first permitted beyond the lens gallery.

Fragments came up the Basalt Stair in miners' sacks, sold by weight, and the Astronomer catalogued every one. Chart 41 records a fall. Chart 42 records a hearth.

Of what lay between, the catalogue is silent.

communionCard.flavor:
Sharing of warmth, as kept at the Tidebound Chapel.

The Saints raised that chapel upon the Drowned Coast to keep watch upon the Spire, which they called heresy. Its congregation shrank with each winter after the Spire was finished.

We watched from Tidebound Chapel and never saw the heresy lit.

Sorcery of three stars, after the Goldbough crest.

Three flames upon three twigs. The Chapel taught that the crest came first, and the stars were named for it.

The Starwatch's oldest plate, cut before the kingdom, shows the same three stars, and a faint fourth. The Chapel's copy omits it.

contagion.flavor:
Communion of the Feral Ember.

The Chapel passed one cup along the pews, that the congregation be one body before the fire. The Feral Ember revived the rite with another cup.

We pass one cup along the pews, and every mouth is red.

coupDeGrace.flavor:
Finishing thrust of the Court's surgeons.

They called it a courtesy and billed it as a procedure, listed between stitching and funeral in their fee schedule. The docks learned it watching the surgeons at work upon the bridges after the Burning.

The schedule has since been amended by hand. The price has risen.

crawlingShot.flavor:
A tired hand finds another line.

Recruits practiced on the Bastion's worn courtyard until their boots found the same stones without looking. Veterans watched the shoulders rather than the weapon. After the Burning, the surviving lessons were passed from one tired pair of hands to another.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

crimsonCleave.flavor:
Wide cut of the Fell Courtyard watch.

Taught for a gate choked with bodies. On the night the Bastion burned, the dead came up the Muster Stair in numbers the watch had no word for, and this was the only answer it had.

The gate log names the watch whole at the bell. Its hand changes halfway down the page.

Chalice of the high altar.

Reserved to the Saints. It draws from the Saint as the Saint draws from it. The Furnace Saint performs the rite alone now, and keeps the chalice full.

We drink from the chalice, and it drinks from us.

Pane of starstone, cut as the great lens was cut.

The great lens cracked in the frost of the eclipse, yet held the light. The Astronomer credited his grinding.

Maud Vell, who ground it, said the crack had closed a little by morning. She would not grind another.

Rite of gathering the failing.

Performed in the sick-wards of the crown-born, that the dying need not linger. The Wandering Physician, who served in those wards, kept his own list of those gathered. The ward rolls name none of them.

Many he had expected to recover.

dazed.flavor:
Light behind the eyes, left by a Grave Wisp.

Those who have seen a wisp up close say it looked at them as if reading.

Close your eyes. Do not speak your name until the light is gone.
dazed.name: Dazed

deadlyTempoCard.flavor:
Rhythm of the frozen docks.

The dock clock froze at the Burning, its hands upon the King's Hour. Before, thieves timed their work by it, and the Court timed its watch by the same.

Since then the docks keep time by their own pulses, and no two agree.

deadlyTempoCard.textTemplate: At the start of your turn, become Prepared and draw a card.

deathblow.flavor:
Killing stroke of the frozen docks.

Struck where the river keeps what the surgeons leave. The river does not thaw, the docks say, because it is full, and the Court built more bridges rather than ask why.

Beneath the ice the Marrow Organist plays the funeral service. He has never reached its end.

deathblow.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. If the target has Bleed, deal {damage.2} more. If it has Venom, deal {damage.3} more.

decayCounter.flavor:
The bitter garden receives another seed.

Gardeners beneath the Chapel sifted bitter ash through exhausted soil. A root could be fed or strangled by the same handful, depending on the season. Their last ledger names each bed twice, once for its bloom and once for its silence.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

defend.flavor:
First guard of the road.

Two crossed lines upon a cairn stone: hold. Cut by climbers for climbers, before the Burning, when the ring was closed to the unmarked.

The mark does not say what to hold against, nor for how long.
defend.name: Defend

desperateRite.flavor:
Rite for when the bier is already made.

The rubric bids the officiant pray louder, and nothing more. The Saints held that the fire heeds the strength of a voice; the novices, that the rubric was written for the family.

The Herald has performed it upon themselves.

Spin practised in the Hall of Mirrors.

The Glass Regent's mirrors are the frozen river beneath the bridges, and they show more than stands before them. Thieves who went in for the silver learned to turn a courtier until he lost the throne.

It is said the Regent herself now reigns from the wrong side of the glass.

dissonance.flavor:
Two true notes, struck a hair apart.

The Observatory's choir was forbidden the interval, for it turned the listener's own voice against the throat. Cantors who sang it by accident forgot their next line for a week.

The choir book still lists it, struck through twice.

divineCounter.flavor:
A patient lamp answers the darkness.

Pilgrims carried little lamps through the Chapel's long passages, tending each flame before their own food. The rite outlived the voices that taught it. An empty hand held over a stranger's wound still remembers the warmth of that watch.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

dodgeRoll.flavor:
Tumble of the ship-breakers.

Learned upon hulls that shift with every tide at the Grave of Ships. The hulls were already rotting at anchor when the trade stopped, and on the night of the Burning, every hold went warm at once.

Gull-Bet's gang opened the holds the following spring. She has not said what was inside.

dreamHarvest.flavor:
The second chair receives a remembered guest.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

drowsingMote.flavor:
The lens holds a quiet drifting light.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

earthGrounding.flavor:
The broken stair returns its thunder to stone.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

emberCommunion.flavor:
The Chapel's last cup.

When the censer cooled, the celebrant passed its remaining warmth among the wounded. The rubric called the sharing a waste. Those who received it called it enough.

No name was entered in the Chapel's ledger that night.

emberCovenant.flavor:
The watch accepts a coal that cannot be returned.

The Bastion's night watch carried coals between the outer posts. A dying ember could reveal a footprint beneath fresh snow, or warn a sleeping guard before the gate gave way. Every watchman learned to keep the smallest flame alive.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

A watchman keeps one ember ready.

The Bastion's night watch carried coals between the outer posts. A dying ember could reveal a footprint beneath fresh snow, or warn a sleeping guard before the gate gave way. Every watchman learned to keep the smallest flame alive.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

The Chapel's name for the night of the Burning.

The night the fire read the names of the crown-born all at once. The novices say the censers swung untouched through it, as the congregation burned around them. The censers of the Furnace Chapel have not stopped since.

We kept the censer swinging when the hearth went dark.
emberTideCard.name: Ember Tide

emberVigil.flavor:
A coal kept through the cloudy night.

On nights the reach would not clear, the Astronomer bade one apprentice keep an ember lit beneath the great lens, lest the lens forget warmth. None knew what he meant.

The lens was cold the morning after the eclipse. The apprentice was gone.

Sea salt, rubbed into a wound.

The ship-breakers swear by it. Salt, they say, is the one thing upon the ring the fire has never touched, for nothing written survives the sea.

They have not seen what the Tidebound Abbey keeps in its boathouse.

enterBulwark.flavor:
The holding stance, second of the Wardens' two.

Low and square, shield set to the hinge side. The Wardens called the gate a wall a man could carry, and held that no gate kept in this stance had ever fallen.

That teaching was set down before the Burning, and was never amended.

enterGorefire.flavor:
The breaking stance, first of the Wardens' two.

The drill is to hold the flame in the blade, not the hand. Sergeants warned that the stance takes the hand if held too long. Sellswords held it longest of all, which the Wardens took for greed.

Hold the flame in the blade; it still takes the hand.
enterGorefire.name: Enter: Gorefire

entomb.flavor:
The ground closes over a held breath.

Bastion engineers sealed a breached gallery with the breachers still inside, and entered the act in the log as repair. The stone has been warm to the touch ever since.

The gallery is still being repaired.

envenomCard.flavor:
Poison from a surgeon's second shelf.

The second shelf held what the first could not treat. Thieves who entered the surgeons' houses after the Burning found the second shelves full and the first bare.

The apprentices will not say which was emptied first.
envenomCard.name: Envenom
envenomCard.textTemplate: Your attacks apply 1 Venom per stack.

evasiveGuard.flavor:
Sidestep of the Pale Marches ice-fishers.

The lakes have not thawed since the Burning. The ice cracks all the year round, and gives only beneath a second pair of feet; the fishers learned to trust the sound.

Widow Arne of Sallow Lake says the sound changed last winter. She fishes no longer.

executionWindow.flavor:
The moment the watch looks away.

Every guard has one. In the years of the Mark Trade, the watch's were written into the roster for a fee: the hours each bridge would stand unguarded, and beside each hour, a name.

None of those names appear in any Court record.

executioner.flavor:
Finishing blow of the Fell Warden.

Taught before his leg went the way of the weald and his blade was ground into a cane. The field-book holds that he never struck a man already kneeling.

The last page in his hand, dated the night of the Burning, is a list of kneeling men.

exsanguinate.flavor:
Giving of blood, until the giver is light enough to rise.

Performed by the Saints in the last extremity, when a hearth faltered and no other offering remained. The Chapel's record names those who performed it and rose.

The graves assigned to them were found empty.

fanOfKnives.flavor:
Surgeon's roll of scalpels, thrown as one.

The rolls reach the docks more often than their owners, sold by ice-cutters who find them frozen into the river, the coat still about them. The surgeons tried to flee the Citadel on the night of the Burning.

The ice closed over those who ran.

Oldest trick of the frozen docks.

Eyes on the purse, hand on the knife. The docks say the Court's knights were easily taken, for they had sworn to look wherever a threat was declared.

No such clause appears in their oath-book. The knights wrote the oath-book.

Boiled by someone who expected to need it, and did not return for it. The custom reached the hamlets with Chapel refugees after the Burning; the hamlets kept the custom, and let the prayer go.

Some rags arrive embroidered with names. The hamlets unpick them.

flagellation.flavor:
Penance of the Chapel's novices.

Performed with a knotted cord upon the bare back. The Saints taught that pain offered freely spares the fire the trouble of taking it. Novice Wen kept the penance daily for three years.

She wrote that she could not say whom it had spared.
flagellation.name: Flagellation

flameToBlade.flavor:
Lanternwood oil, set alight upon the edge.

A late practice of the Wardens, adopted when plain steel no longer frightened what came out of the weald. The Chapel frowned upon Wardens bearing fire they had not been given.

Mind the sleeve; the oil takes it before the enemy.

forceCounter.flavor:
A held weight waits for its answer.

At the Basalt Stair, porters steadied heavy crates without touching their broken handles. The Astronomer recorded the trick as a measured displacement. Those who carried the crates remembered only the sudden weight in their wrists when their concentration failed.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

frostCounter.flavor:
Winter keeps the answering touch.

The Starwatch kept bowls of water beside the lenses through winter. Apprentices learned to read the skin of ice before it cracked. Their notes survived the Burning, folded inside cloth that still stiffens when a stranger touches it.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

Ring of cold, after the frozen ash of the caldera.

Miners found such rings about fresh falls upon the caldera floor. Coll, a foreman, told the apprentices the ash froze before the stone landed. The Astronomer named miners unreliable witnesses.

He bought Coll's next fragment at double the price.

goreblood.flavor:
The Wardens' name for blood-madness.

The state in which a fighter has spilled enough of their own blood that fear no longer holds. In sworn men the Wardens called it virtue; in sellswords, vice. The two are described in the same words.

Its only instruction: keep standing.
goreblood.name: Goreblood
goreblood.textTemplate: Poise thresholds no longer increase after filling.

gorefireSlash.flavor:
Art of the sellswords of the Bastion.

The hired blades who held the Fell Courtyard wetted their steel with their own blood before each watch, for the Gorefire takes more readily to a blade already red.

The Wardens called it discipline. The sellswords knew it as a price, paid in advance.
gorefireSlash.name: Gorefire Slash
gorefireSlash.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {bleed} Bleed and {burn} Burn.

goreslash.flavor:
Short cut of the Bastion's hired blades.

The sellswords had no patience for the Wardens' long forms. A long cut belongs in songs, they said, and the songs of the Bastion were paid for by the Wardens.

The sellswords kept a verse of their own. Only its tune survives.
goreslash.name: Goreslash

graveOffering.flavor:
Offering at the graves of the crown-born.

Upon the anniversary of their writing, mourners opened the grave and set a coal beside what remained. The Chapel ended the rite in the years of the Marking, saying the dead no longer needed company.

By then, the mourners had found the graves colder than they ought to be.

graveOffering.textTemplate: Lose {loseHp} HP. Deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies.

graveWisp.curse.name: Curse
graveWisp.curse.textTemplate: Shuffle Dazed into the enemy's draw.

gravityWell.flavor:
Pull of the Observatory's great pendulum.

The pendulum swung true for most of the Starwatch's history. In the years the Spire was built, it leaned toward the coast, and did not recover.

The Astronomer ordered the foundations inspected. The report is blank.

greatswordSunderingHew.flavor:
Hew of a Court knight's greatsword.

Too heavy to carry far, and too dear to leave. The corrupted knights pause at the sight of one in a Forsaken's hands, unable to believe an unmarked hand holds their steel.

That pause is worth the weight.

groundedResolve.flavor:
Dry hands hold fast to the stone.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
groundedResolve.name: Grounded Resolve
groundedResolve.textTemplate: Break {removeStatus} Paralysis. If paralyzed when played, gain {grounded} Grounded.

guardCounter.flavor:
Riposte of the sworn Wardens.

The enemy commits; the Bastion answers, and its answer is always the greater. So the Wardens taught the drill, and so they told of the Spring Wars, in which they claimed never to have struck first.

The Northern Holds remember it otherwise.

guardianBulwark.flavor:
The Wardens' holding stance, learned from the shield.

A shield that stood in the Bastion's line keeps the habit, the elders say, and pulls the arm into place. They call it superstition.

They tell climbers to carry Bastion shields, and never Court ones.
guardianBulwark.name: Enter: Bulwark

guilt.flavor:
What follows looting at the Second Cairn.

The second time is easier. That is how climbers know the ring has begun on them.
guilt.name: Guilt
guilt.textTemplate: Unplayable. At the end of your turn, if this is in your hand, lose {loseHp} HP.

hamstring.flavor:
Cut at the back of the leg.

Taught upon the road with a single instruction: all things of the ring walk, so go for the legs. The saying is scratched on cairns from the weald to the coast, weeks apart.

It is cut in the same hand on every one.
hamstring.name: Hamstring
hamstring.textTemplate: Apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable to ALL enemies. Exhaust.

hamstringRogue.flavor:
Cut behind the knee.

The docks' answer to the stitched knights, who cannot kneel, and once fallen cannot rise. The surgeons called the knights unbending. On the docks, the word is taken as written.

The Fourth Bridge rail bears a tally of knights left upon the ice.
hamstringRogue.name: Hamstring

harbingerOfBlightCard.flavor:
Title of the Feral Ember's preachers.

The Chapel gave the same name to the novice who walked before a bier with a bell. The Feral Ember holds that the word was never the Chapel's to give, but the fire's.

We go before the fire, and it follows us gladly.
harbingerOfBlightCard.name: Harbinger of Blight
harbingerOfBlightCard.textTemplate: Whenever Blight (Crimson or Necrotic) is applied to an enemy, heal 1 HP.

hemorrhage.flavor:
Second cut, laid into an open wound.

The Court's surgeons, who studied such matters, recorded that Wardens bled longer than other men beneath the knife, and blamed the thinness of field-born blood. The finding was signed by the surgeons as one body.

No cases were attached to it.
hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage

upgrade.textTemplate: Double the target's Bleed.

hewingArc.flavor:
A wide cut that opens old wounds.

Taught in the Vanguard's yard to recruits who had never held a blade. The sergeants said the arc forgives a poor grip, and the Gorefire does the rest.

The yard is ash now. The recruits still swing it wide, as they were shown.
hewingArc.name: Hewing Arc
hewingArc.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies. If in Gorefire Stance: apply {bleed} Bleed to ALL.

hex.flavor:
Sign scratched upon a door.

The hamlets mark it on houses where someone marked burns slowly within, to keep it from coming out. They learned the sign from the Chapel, which set it upon the houses of the unmarked before the Decree.

The hamlets call it fair to use it the other way round.
hex.name: Hex

holySpark.flavor:
A pilgrim cups the remaining warmth.

Pilgrims carried little lamps through the Chapel's long passages, tending each flame before their own food. The rite outlived the voices that taught it. An empty hand held over a stranger's wound still remembers the warmth of that watch.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
holySpark.name: Holy Spark

honedEdge.flavor:
Whetstone from the cairn.

At the Grave of the Nameless, the custom is to take one and leave one. The stones are weald sandstone, marches slate, black glass of the reach. One is starstone.

Within the year, someone always carries it back.
honedEdge.name: Honed Edge

huskBrute.bellow.name: Bellow
huskBrute.bellow.textTemplate: Apply {frail} Frail to the enemy. Shuffle Slimed into the enemy's discard.

illusionCounter.flavor:
The second reflection keeps its distance.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
illusionCounter.name: Illusion Counter
illusionCounter.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a illusion Counter: 1 Ward and 1 Poise return.

illusionDecoy.flavor:
A warm chair waits for an absent companion.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.
illusionDecoy.name: Illusion Decoy
illusionDecoy.textTemplate: Gain {decoy} Decoy: avoid a Single Reach/Ranged damaging action. Status buildup still applies; Sweep and Holy reveal it.

impale.flavor:
Pinning thrust of the weald hamlets.

Learned in the first winter of the Blight, against what rose from the drowned hamlet and would not stay down. A pinned thing stops, the hamlets say. The Wardens would once have burned such things.

But the fire went into the Wardens that winter.
impale.name: Impale
impale.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. If the target is Staggered: apply {bleed} Bleed.

ironResolve.flavor:
Standing order of the Bastion.

Read at the muster peal: a Warden holds until relieved, and relief comes by the bell. The bell-roll kept the names of all who held.

After the Burning, the roll runs on for many pages, in a hand no scribe knew, bearing names no Warden ever enlisted.
ironResolve.name: Iron Resolve
ironResolve.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. If in Bulwark Stance: gain {block.2} instead.

ironSkin.flavor:
Plate of cold iron, worn where a flame-mark would lie.

First worn by the ice-fishers of the Pale Marches in the year of the Decree, when the Court's brand-men came for the unmarked. Such plates are left upon the Grave of the Nameless for those who climb after.

Most have been worn thin by more than one wearer.
ironSkin.name: Iron Skin

ironVowCard.flavor:
Oath of the Wardens, sworn with the sword hand upon the gate.

Sworn Wardens bore the flame-mark from birth, and the oath was laid over it as a second promise. Sellswords swore it with no first promise beneath, and so the Wardens held them less bound.

What that meant on the night of the Burning, no oath foretold.
ironVowCard.name: Iron Vow
ironVowCard.textTemplate: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Block.

katanaDrawCut.flavor:
Single cut from the scabbard, as it is done beyond the marches.

The curved blades reached the ring in the years of the Mark Trade, borne by foreign lords who paid to be warm there. They burned with the rest of the marked, far from home, and left their swords where they fell.

The merchant knows whose each one was. He sells that separately.
katanaDrawCut.name: Draw Cut

kickOff.flavor:
Boot-strike of the Muster Stair.

Sellswords learned it upon steps steep enough that the fall does the killing. The Wardens forbade it as common, and had adopted it within a season.

What is kicked from the stair now climbs it again.

kilnCleave.flavor:
Axe of the Dead Foundry.

The Foundry's fires went out with the Crown Flame, and its forges have been warm ever since, though none has lit them. Corran, a foundryman, broke this axe from a cold mould at dawn and carried it up the Basalt Stair.

He says no one poured it.

kilnCleave.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {burn} Burn. Deal {poiseDamage} Poise damage.

kindledOmen.flavor:
A sign read in sparks, then set upon a foe.

The apprentices threw pinches of ash into the brazier and named the shapes the sparks made. Most were nothing. A few were names of the living.

Those whose names were read seldom lived the year, and the practice was stopped.

kindledOmen.textTemplate: Apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable and {burn} Burn. Starstone: draw {draw} card.

lastMercy.flavor:
Warming of a dying hand.

The Chapel's nursing sisters did it with a coal wrapped in cloth, that the fire might find the hand gentle. The Wandering Physician learned it from them, and does it without the coal.

It seems to work as well. He cannot say what working means.

lastRites.flavor:
Rite for those not to be written.

Foreigners, criminals, and in the last years, the bought-marked of whom the Chapel had not been told. The rubric forbids a name upon the headstone, and calls this discretion.

The lower cemetery stands blank by the thousand.

lastStand.flavor:
Final entry of the Fell Courtyard gate log.

One gate, one man, it reads. The man is not named, as though the writer thought none would need it.

The dead are counted twice upon the page, and the counts do not agree.

lastStand.textTemplate: Ethereal. Gain Block equal to your missing HP (max 20).

upgrade.textTemplate: Ethereal. Gain Block equal to your missing HP (max 30).

lethalDose.flavor:
Whole vial, all at once.

The surgeons measured doses by the drop and wrote each one down. The docks pour the vial and write nothing, which is why the surgeons' ledgers hold so many unexplained recoveries.

The docks' ledgers hold the rest.
lethalDose.name: Lethal Dose
lethalDose.textTemplate: Deal 6 damage plus 4 times the target's Venom, then remove its Venom. Exhaust.

lifeTitheCard.flavor:
Tithe of life, owed by each crown-born family.

One day in seven, given to the Chapel's work, as the dead had given all their days. In the years of the Marking, the tithe was extended to newborns, who could not work.

We bring the cradle where the bier once stood.
lifeTitheCard.name: Life Tithe
lifeTitheCard.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, heal 8 HP.

lightningCounter.flavor:
The returning current remembers every rail.

Storms found the Observatory's iron stairs long before any scholar could name their path. Apprentices marked the scorched rails, then wrapped their hands in dry cloth. The surviving diagrams begin with a warning to watch where the current returns.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

lightningCounter.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a lightning Counter: 2 Ward return.

litany.flavor:
Closing prayer of the funeral rite.

Spoken over the ledger once a name was entered, and said to return a share of warmth to the mourners. Novices learned it before they could read. The last novice says it each night.

The ledger was lost in the Burning. There is no name to close.
litany.name: Litany
